name: staff-brand-membership-sync
title: Synchronize new staff with active business context
description: Create the staff BrandMembership from the manager workspace Brand and restaurant active at submit time; keep restaurantForStaff as compatibility data only.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: The normalized add flow sends request-only staffBusinessContext from the active manager restaurant and its Brand.
